cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiastic interest in the Social Media & Community Marketeer position at prado, as advertised. Your innovative approach to invisible home technology and your commitment to growth resonate deeply with my own professional drive. My experience at the intersection of digital marketing, content creation, and AI-driven optimization positions me as a strong candidate eager to contribute to your dynamic marketing team.

My recent roles as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto and Web & SEO Specialist at Knowledge Experts have provided me with comprehensive experience in managing, updating, and optimizing online content for diverse client websites. I have actively published blog posts and pages using WordPress and Elementor, ensuring content aligns with specific brand guidelines and drives organic traffic. This background directly relates to assisting with writing, creating, scheduling, and publishing posts across your multiple brands and markets, as well as contributing to a cohesive social media content calendar. My experience also includes integrating social media components into website designs.

Crucially, I bring practical expertise in leveraging AI tools for content creation, a skill specifically mentioned in your requirements. I use LLMs like Claude and ChatGPT daily for research, content generation, and audits, enhancing efficiency and creativity. Furthermore, my analytical proficiency with Google Analytics and Search Console directly supports the monitoring of engagement data, allowing me to identify opportunities for improving content formats and frequency. This data-driven approach ensures social media efforts are continuously refined and impactful.

I am organised, proactive, and comfortable handling multiple tasks, having managed content for various client sites like etkendanismanlik.com and proteinbox.com.tr. My strong writing and editing skills, cultivated through SEO blog and website content creation, can adapt to different brand voices, and I am fluent in both English and Dutch. I am keen to apply my collaborative mindset and passion for digital innovation to help prado expand its reach and engagement within the US market and beyond.

Thank you for considering my application. I am excited by the prospect of contributing to prado's continued success and am available for an interview at your earliest convenience.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
- Experienced in SEO blog & content writing and CMS content management (WordPress, Elementor) across multiple client websites, including social media integration.
- Daily use of LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT) for research, content generation, and audits, directly enhancing content creation.
- Proficient in analytics and reporting tools (Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Semrush) to monitor performance and identify growth opportunities.
- Track record of managing content and optimizing for organic traffic for various brands/markets (e.g., Episto and Knowledge Experts clients).
- Fluent in English and proficient in Dutch, with strong writing and editing skills adaptable to different brand voices.
